metadata.note: Names supplied by user; all other details, readings, coordinates and histories are invented. No actual hardware or rider behavior is represented.
metadata.auth_note: Public profiles only; no Supabase Auth accounts, usable passwords, PINs or biometrics. Provided users DDL has no auth.users FK; triggers/RLS were not supplied.
metadata.snapshot_note: Fixed September 23, 2026 snapshot; online/ongoing are simulated and do not update.
metadata.brac_note: Values test current application cutoff only; physical units/calibration are not established.
metadata.contact_note: Phone values are fictional Philippine-style mobile number examples and are not verified or intended for contact.
